//: Server dev watcher. Switched from `node --watch` because Node 25's watcher restarted the process whenever a dep in node_modules (e.g. pdf-parse's dynamic imports during a bill upload) touched files it had loaded — killing in-flight requests, which the Vite proxy surfaces to the browser as a bare text/plain 500 with no server-side stack trace. Nodemon ignores node_modules by default and only restarts on OUR source changes.
